summary: Groton New London Airport is a regional public-use airport serving southeastern Connecticut, situated in the town of Groton near the Thames River and Long Island Sound. It primarily supports general aviation, corporate travel, flight training, and charter operations, serving as a convenient gateway to nearby attractions including Mystic Seaport, the Naval Submarine Base New London, and coastal Connecticut communities.
